text:
**Native forest loss was detected, but deforestation is not established.** In 2022, about 0.6 hectares of tree-cover loss was mapped on the property, of which 0.5 hectares overlapped forest mapped as native in 2021.

The evidence does not establish the cause of the loss or whether the land was converted to another use. An additional 0.2 hectares of loss was detected in smaller patches, but not counted as an event under the method.
